people.name: Asmita Sarkar
people.bio: Artist-researcher and Associate Professor, Srishti Manipal Institute of Art, Design and Technology. Works on the phenomenology of embodiment and metaphor in contemporary painting.

people.name: Arnab Barik
people.bio: PI, Barik Lab, Centre for Neuroscience, IISc Bengaluru. Studies the neural circuits of pain and itch, and how stress, fear and hunger modulate pain.

people.bio: Contributes the ongoing *Diary Pages* — pale, intimate, first-person watercolours, a durational counterpart to the exhibition's explanatory voice.
